assertion_analysis.test_a_failed_owner_census_is_never_repo: False completeness and incomplete/unavailable text fail if refusal becomes a complete empty census or the caveat is removed.
assertion_analysis.test_admission_reads_the_local_disk_and_: Low-space kind fails when guard returns None; high-space None fails on unconditional holds; missing local path must return unreadable. Remote-with-no-publication None expectation records the fail-open gap, not protection.
assertion_analysis.test_direct_and_published_obligations_in: Exactly one direct notice fails on omission/duplication; equality fails on disagreement between runtime readers, but parity alone does not independently establish pressure correctness.
assertion_analysis.test_disk_pressure_prevents_both_named_a: Named and service variants require no launches, held identity and recorded hold. Removing the guard loses held/verdict assertions. Equality to injected pressure/reason tests propagation only; pressure generation is covered separately. The pointer lacks queued_at, so forbidden_launch by itself is not sufficient proof of refusal; held assertions still discriminate guard removal.
assertion_analysis.test_each_mount_records_its_own_independ: Mount identity fails on wrong identity; total/used/free arithmetic and inode equality fail on wrong statvfs fields or units; cross-row inequality fails on shared readings. A one-mount mutation is recorded failing at line 65. Fixtures supply raw block counts, not expected output bytes.
assertion_analysis.test_flight_reserve_default_and_override: 8 GiB literal fails on changed default or broken resolution; 123 assertion checks configuration plumbing only and fails if override ignored. ValueError context fails if negative settings accepted.
assertion_analysis.test_pressure_names_largest_entries_and_: Complete flag, ranked path, >=32768 bytes and uid fail on skipped/truncated/wrongly attributed census. Kind, path and owner substring assertions fail on omitted notice content. Owner is propagated from low largest_entries, so that substring assertion alone does not validate owner lookup; independent uid and real filesystem entry assertions carry attribution coverage. Large-mount and exact-reserve None assertions fail on unconditional pressure or <= threshold.
assertion_analysis.test_remote_admission_uses_the_published: Original remote-return-None code fails expected low-space obligation equality; forbidden_local_sample fails if remote host samples its own disk; recovery None fails on unconditional hold. Expected derives from the shared obligation reader, so this is parity/plumbing coverage rather than an independent sample-freshness check.
assertion_analysis.test_sample_publishes_the_same_four_fiel: Exit code and stdout-to-publication equality fail on publication failure or disagreement; equality against published input checks propagation only, not physical measurement. Changing job id must yield None or identity rejection regressed.
assertion_analysis.test_sampler_appends_all_disk_fields: Return-code and exact four-column assertions fail on sampler failure, missing/misordered values or column removal; recorded base reproduction fails on missing node_tmp_total_bytes.
assertion_analysis.test_sampler_failure_keeps_unknown_disk_: Return-code assertion fails if probe failure aborts the sampler; all(...) fails if an existing disk column becomes zero or blank instead of unknown. all(...) alone is vacuous if all columns disappear; the first test separately requires all four columns.

evidence_limits: Official manifest suite pair adds zero failures; separate importer receipts add four ids, recorded under outside_scope in the review manifest. No live one-hour observation was supplied; no suite rerun by reviewer.

findings.text: blocking: Remote admission returns no hold when the published sample is missing or unreadable, and published_node_disk_sample at fleet_supervisor.py:532 checks only job/node identity with no freshness bound; a failed sampler leaves an old healthy sample usable indefinitely, allowing launches below reserve, or an old low-space sample holding launches after recovery. Return an unreadable/stale hold for a known remote fleet until a current reading is available, and test missing, unreadable and expired samples.
